summary: This bill expands Medicare, Medicaid, and CHIP coverage to include specific cancer diagnostic and laboratory tests, such as next-generation sequencing, for individuals diagnosed with cancer, and directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to establish an education program on genomic testing.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands Medicare, Medicaid, and CHIP coverage to include cancer diagnostic and laboratory tests. By increasing access to these tests through public health programs, it moves towards more public healthcare access.

The bill mandates new Medicare, Medicaid, and CHIP coverage for cancer diagnostic tests with no offsets or revenue measures, directly increasing federal outlays to expand access to a priority service.

Virtually the entire bill consists of statutory mandates requiring government health programs to cover genomic cancer testing, an explicit government-driven expansion of coverage rather than any market-based approach.
